queries.result: French/Arabic discovery found the official Tipaza cadastral directorate route and official DGDN cadastral-document/e-service descriptions. Results describe document delivery and professional access, but did not expose an anonymous map or parcel-geometry endpoint for Koléa.

registryBasis: The official DGDN/Agence Nationale du Cadastre Tipaza page evidences the wilaya cadastral directorate, its cadastral-document guide, public/professional e-service routes, and the official Tipaza contact. This establishes a local/wilaya cadastral custodian/procedure, not an open Koléa parcel layer.

requests.outcome: Official DGDN Tipaza page was available through indexed first-party content; it identified the Tipaza cadastral directorate, cadastral e-service/document links, and official contact information.
Official DGDN home page described online cadastral-document delivery and stated that the Centre region includes Tipaza; it did not provide public parcel geometry or a Koléa map query.
Official cadastral-document route was linked by the viewer, but the anonymous fetch timed out; no login or retry escalation was used.
The public e-service link resolved to a malformed/dynamic route in the indexed viewer and timed out; no credentials, private token, or bypass was attempted.

Official ASGA cartographic viewer was discovered, but its 1:200,000 map viewer timed out. Its indexed layer list was general cartography (communes/wilayas), not a verified parcel layer; no geometry was retained.

source: Direction Générale du Domaine National / Agence Nationale du Cadastre, Tipaza directorate
